trs.tran: 机器学习：人工智能的一个分支，指计算机利用算法从数据中学习规律、建立统计模型，并随着新数据的加入不断提高自身性能的过程，通常无需针对每个任务进行显式编程。
《Machine Learning》：一种同行评审学术期刊，创刊于 1986 年，主要发表机器学习领域的研究论文。

sentence-pair.sentence: Machine learning is now capable of far, far more complex tasks.
sentence-pair.sentence-eng: Machine learning is now capable of far, far more complex tasks.
sentence-pair.sentence-translation: 机器学习现在能够完成极其复杂的任务。

sentence-pair.sentence: My company, Kaggle, operates on the cutting edge of machine learning.
sentence-pair.sentence-eng: My company, Kaggle, operates on the cutting edge of machine learning.
sentence-pair.sentence-translation: 我的公司 Kaggle 在机器学习领域处于领先地位。

sentence-pair.sentence: Machine learning started making its way into the industry in the early 90s.
sentence-pair.sentence-eng: Machine learning started making its way into the industry in the early 90s.
sentence-pair.sentence-translation: 机器学习在90年代早期开始进入工业领域。
